findings.title: GKE targets hardcode internal_ip = true but worker_pool may be null, so deploys cannot reach the control plane
findings.explanation: Every GKE target is created with gke.internal_ip = true, which makes Cloud Deploy talk to the control plane's private IP. var.worker_pool defaults to null (the default Cloud Build pool), which has no network path to a private control-plane address, so render/deploy jobs for GKE targets fail at runtime even though apply succeeds. No rule covers Cloud Deploy targets.
findings.remediation: Require var.worker_pool whenever any target sets gke_cluster (lifecycle precondition on google_clouddeploy_target.main), keeping the private-endpoint access path.

findings.title: Releasers get clouddeploy.releaser but no actAs on the execution SA, so their releases are rejected
findings.explanation: Cloud Deploy requires the principal creating a release or rollout to hold iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on the target execution service account. The module grants that to the automation SA (automation_act_as) but not to var.releasers, so the members the module claims to enable as releasers get PERMISSION_DENIED on release creation unless actAs is granted out of band, typically too broadly at project level.
findings.remediation: Grant roles/iam.serviceAccountUser on var.execution_service_account (and only on it) to each member of var.releasers.

suggested_policies.rationale: A GKE Cloud Deploy target that reaches the control plane by internal IP without a private worker pool fails every deploy; this is a single-resource attribute combination that holds for any Terraform using google_clouddeploy_target, and no policy covers the type today.
suggested_policies.yaml:
id: LOCAL_GCP_001
name: Cloud Deploy GKE targets using internal_ip must run jobs on a private worker pool
principle: reliability
severity: MEDIUM
rationale: |
  With gke.internal_ip = true Cloud Deploy reaches the cluster control plane on its
  private IP. The default Cloud Build pool has no route to that address, so every
  deploy job fails unless execution_configs sets a private worker_pool.
message: |
  google_clouddeploy_target sets gke.internal_ip = true but execution_configs.worker_pool is not set.
remediation: |
  Set execution_configs.worker_pool to a private Cloud Build worker pool peered with
  the cluster's VPC, or set gke.internal_ip = false for a public-endpoint cluster.
resources:
  google_clouddeploy_target:
    any:
      - path: gke.internal_ip
        not_equals: true
      - path: execution_configs.worker_pool
        not_null: true
